dishes.name: Doro Wat
steps: Cook chopped onions slowly in a dry pot until deeply softened and golden (20-30 min).
Add niter kibbeh, cook a few minutes.
Add berbere, cook until fragrant and darker red.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 2-3 minutes.
Add water to loosen sauce, then chicken, coating well.
Cover and simmer 45-60 minutes until chicken is tender.
Add boiled eggs, simmer 10 more minutes.
Finish with lemon, serve with injera.

dishes.name: Key Wat (Beef Stew)
steps: Cook onions slowly until deeply softened, 15-20 min.
Add niter kibbeh then berbere, cook until fragrant.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 2-3 min.
Add beef and water, simmer covered 45-60 min until tender.
Serve hot with injera.

dishes.name: Sega Alicha (Mild Beef Stew)
steps: Sauté onion in niter kibbeh until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, and turmeric, cook until fragrant.
Add beef and a little water, cover and simmer 45-50 min until tender.
Serve with injera or rice.

dishes.name: Doro Alicha (Mild Chicken Stew)
steps: Sauté onion in niter kibbeh until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, turmeric, cook until fragrant.
Add chicken, coat well, add a little water, simmer covered 40 min.
Add boiled eggs, simmer 10 more minutes.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Tibs
steps: Heat niter kibbeh in a pan over high heat.
Sear meat cubes until browned.
Add onion and rosemary, cook until softened.
Add peppers and tomato, cook 5 min.
Stir in berbere if using, cook 2-3 more min.
Serve sizzling hot with injera or bread.

dishes.name: Zilzil Tibs (Strips of Beef)
steps: Sear thin beef strips in hot niter kibbeh until browned but tender.
Add onion, rosemary, jalapeño, cook 5 min.
Serve immediately, often with mustard sauce on the side.

dishes.name: Gored Gored

ingredients.name: lean beef, cubed raw or lightly seared

steps: Cut beef into small cubes.
Warm niter kibbeh and toss cubes to lightly coat (can be served raw-style or quickly seared).
Serve with mitmita or awaze on the side for dipping.
ingredient_names: lean beef, cubed raw or lightly seared

dishes.name: Dulet
steps: Finely dice tripe, liver, and beef.
Sauté onion and jalapeño in niter kibbeh until soft.
Add diced meats, cook until browned.
Stir in berbere, cook 5 more min.
Serve hot with injera.

dishes.name: Kitfo
steps: Finely mince beef.
Warm niter kibbeh gently until melted.
Mix meat with melted niter kibbeh and mitmita thoroughly.
Stir in koseret or basil if using.
Serve immediately with injera, ayib, and gomen.

dishes.name: Kurt
steps: Cube fresh tenderloin into bite-size pieces.
Serve raw alongside awaze and mustard for dipping.
Traditionally eaten fresh, straight from the cut.

dishes.name: Minchet Abish
steps: Sauté onion in niter kibbeh until soft.
Add berbere and garlic, cook until fragrant.
Add ground beef, breaking it up, cook until browned.
Simmer 15-20 min with a little water, stir in abish powder near the end.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Misir Wat
steps: Sauté onion in oil until golden.
Add garlic and ginger, cook 2 min.
Stir in berbere and tomato paste, cook until fragrant.
Add lentils and water to cover, simmer 25-30 min until thick.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Kik Alicha (Mild Split Pea Stew)
steps: Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Add garlic and turmeric, cook until fragrant.
Add split peas and water to cover, simmer 25 min until soft.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Shiro Wat
steps: Sauté onion in oil until translucent.
Add garlic and tomato, cook until softened.
Add water, bring to a boil.
Whisk in shiro powder gradually to avoid lumps.
Simmer 10-15 min until thickened.
Serve hot with injera.

dishes.name: Gomen (Collard Greens)
steps: Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Add garlic, ginger, jalapeño, cook 2 min.
Add greens and a splash of water, cover and steam-cook 15-20 min until tender.
Season with salt, serve warm with injera.

dishes.name: Atkilt Wat (Cabbage, Carrot & Potato)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add turmeric, stir until fragrant.
Add potatoes and carrots, cook 10 min covered with a splash of water.
Add cabbage, cover, cook 10-15 more min until tender.
Season with salt, serve with injera.

dishes.name: Fosolia (Green Beans & Carrots)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add carrots, cook 5 min.
Add green beans and a splash of water, cover and cook 12-15 min until tender-crisp.
Season with salt, serve warm.

dishes.name: Dinich Alicha (Potato Stew)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add turmeric, cook until fragrant.
Add potatoes and a splash of water, cover, cook 20 min until tender.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Shimbra Asa (Chickpea "Fish")
steps: Make a stiff dough with chickpea flour and water, shape into small fish-like patties.
Steam or pan-fry the patties until firm.
Sauté onion, garlic, and berbere in oil to make a sauce.
Simmer patties in the sauce for 10 min, serve with injera.

dishes.name: Azifa
steps: Cook lentils until tender but not mushy, drain and cool.
Mix in onion, jalapeño, mustard, lemon juice, and olive oil.
Season with salt, chill slightly, serve as a cold salad.

dishes.name: Timatim Salad
steps: Combine diced tomato, onion, and jalapeño.
Dress with lemon juice, olive oil, and salt.
Toss gently, serve as a side.

dishes.name: Ful Medames
steps: Warm cooked fava beans, lightly mashing some.
Stir in tomato, onion, jalapeño.
Add lemon juice and olive oil.
Season with salt, serve warm with bread.

dishes.name: Yataklete Kilkil (Mixed Vegetable Stew)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add potato and carrot, cook 10 min with a splash of water.
Add green beans, cook 10-12 more min until all vegetables are tender.
Add rosemary if using, season with salt, serve warm.

dishes.name: Tikil Gomen (Cabbage & Potato)
steps: Sauté onion in oil, add turmeric until fragrant.
Add potato and carrot, cook 10 min covered.
Add cabbage, cook 10-15 more min until tender.
Season with salt, serve with injera.

dishes.name: Yebeg Wat (Lamb Stew)
steps: Cook onions slowly until softened.
Add niter kibbeh, then berbere, cook until fragrant.
Add garlic and ginger, cook briefly.
Add lamb and water, simmer covered 60 min until tender.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Injera

teff flour: teff + all-purpose flour blend for faster ferment

steps: Mix teff flour and water into a thin batter, whisking out lumps.
Cover and let ferment at room temperature 2-3 days until bubbly and slightly sour.
Heat a large flat non-stick pan (mitad) over medium heat.
Pour a thin, even layer of batter in a spiral from the outside in.
Cover and cook until small bubbles cover the surface and edges lift, about 2-3 min. Do not flip.
Remove and cool on a clean towel; stack for serving.

dishes.name: Kita
steps: Mix flour, water, salt, and oil into a firm dough.
Rest dough 10 minutes.
Flatten into a thick round.
Cook on a dry griddle or pan over medium heat, flipping once, until golden and cooked through (5-8 min per side).

dishes.name: Ambasha
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water, let foam 5-10 min.
Mix flour, cardamom, oil, and yeast mixture into a soft dough.
Knead well, let rise 1 hour until doubled.
Shape into a round loaf, score a decorative pattern on top.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 30-35 min until golden and hollow-sounding when tapped.

dishes.name: Himbasha
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm milk, let foam.
Mix flour, cardamom, oil, raisins, and yeast mixture into a soft dough.
Knead and let rise 1 hour.
Shape into a round, decorate top with a fork or knife pattern.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 30-35 min until golden.

dishes.name: Dabo Kolo
steps: Mix flour, sugar, spice, and oil, then add water to form a firm dough.
Roll into thin ropes and cut into small pellet-sized pieces.
Bake at 160°C (325°F) or pan-toast, stirring often, until golden and crunchy, about 20-25 min.
Cool completely before storing; serve as a snack, often with coffee.

dishes.name: Kolo (Roasted Barley & Nuts)
steps: Dry-roast barley in a pan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until toasted and fragrant, about 10-12 min.
Mix in roasted chickpeas and peanuts if using.
Season with salt, cool, and serve as a snack.

dishes.name: Sambusa

ingredients.name: thin dough wrappers or samosa wraps

steps: Cook filling: sauté onion, add lentils or beef, season with berbere or jalapeño, cook until dry-ish. Cool.
Fill each wrapper with a spoonful of filling, fold into a triangle, sealing edges with a flour-water paste.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crisp, 3-4 min.
Drain on paper towels, serve warm.
ingredient_names: thin dough wrappers or samosa wraps

dishes.name: Genfo
steps: Bring water to a boil.
Gradually whisk in flour, stirring constantly, until a thick porridge forms.
Shape into a mound with a well in the center.
Melt niter kibbeh with berbere, pour into the well.
Serve warm, mixing spiced butter in as you eat.

dishes.name: Kinche
steps: Rinse cracked wheat.
Bring water to a boil, add wheat and salt.
Simmer 25-30 min, stirring occasionally, until soft and thickened.
Stir in niter kibbeh before serving, often with plain yogurt on the side.

dishes.name: Firfir (Injera Firfir)
steps: Sauté onion and garlic in niter kibbeh until soft.
Add berbere, cook until fragrant, add a splash of water to make a light sauce.
Toss torn injera pieces into the sauce until well coated and warmed through.
Serve immediately, often for breakfast.

dishes.name: Chechebsa
steps: If making dough, cook a thick flatbread on a griddle, then tear into pieces.
Melt niter kibbeh, stir in berbere and garlic if using.
Toss torn flatbread in the spiced butter until coated and warmed.
Serve for breakfast, often with plain yogurt.

dishes.name: Ayib (Ethiopian Cottage Cheese)
steps: Warm milk gently until just below boiling.
Add lemon juice, stir gently until curds separate from whey.
Let sit 10 min, then strain through cheesecloth.
Let drain 20-30 min until a soft, crumbly cheese forms.
Serve alongside kitfo, gomen, or spicy wats to balance heat.

dishes.name: Besso (Roasted Barley Drink/Snack)
steps: Toast barley flour lightly in a dry pan if not pre-roasted.
Mix with water or milk to form a thick paste or drink, depending on desired consistency.
Sweeten with sugar if desired, serve as a quick energy snack.

dishes.name: Tere Sega (Raw Beef)

ingredients.name: very fresh beef tenderloin, sliced thin

steps: Slice fresh tenderloin very thin.
Arrange on a plate, serve raw with awaze or mustard for dipping.
Best made with high-quality, very fresh meat from a trusted butcher.
ingredient_names: very fresh beef tenderloin, sliced thin

dishes.name: Zigni (Eritrean Beef Stew)
steps: Sauté onion in niter kibbeh until softened.
Add berbere and tomato paste, cook until fragrant.
Add garlic, then beef, coating well.
Add water, simmer covered 45 min until tender.
Serve with injera or bread.

dishes.name: Tsebhi Derho (Eritrean Chicken Stew)
steps: Cook onions slowly until deeply softened.
Add niter kibbeh, berbere, and tomato paste, cook until fragrant.
Add garlic, then chicken, coating well.
Simmer covered 45-50 min until tender.
Add eggs, simmer 10 more min, serve with injera.

dishes.name: Hilbet (Eritrean Bean/Lentil Paste)
steps: Boil beans or lentils until very soft, then mash or blend into a smooth paste.
Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger in oil until fragrant.
Mix into the bean paste, adjusting water for a thick, spreadable consistency.
Serve as part of a combination platter with injera.

dishes.name: Tihlo
steps: Mix roasted barley flour with hot water to form a stiff dough.
Roll into small balls or dumplings using a special tihlo tool or fingers.
Serve alongside a spicy berbere-based dipping sauce (often made with meat).

dishes.name: Asa Wat (Fish Stew)
steps: Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Add berbere, garlic, and tomato, cook until fragrant.
Add water to make a sauce, bring to a simmer.
Add fish pieces, cook gently 10-12 min until just cooked through.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Kai Sir (Beet Salad/Stew)
steps: Boil beets and potatoes separately until tender.
Sauté onion in oil until soft, add jalapeño if using.
Combine cooked beets and potatoes with the sautéed onion, toss gently.
Season with salt, serve warm or at room temperature.

dishes.name: Kitfo Leb Leb (Lightly Cooked Kitfo)
steps: Warm niter kibbeh in a pan.
Add minced beef and mitmita, cook briefly over low heat just until the meat turns from red to pink (a few minutes, not fully cooked through).
Serve warm with injera, ayib, and gomen.

dishes.name: Siljo
steps: Whisk ground flaxseed and mustard powder into water to form a smooth, slightly thick base.
Stir in berbere and garlic.
Simmer gently 15-20 min, stirring often, until it thickens slightly.
Serve as a tangy, spicy side with injera.

dishes.name: Marek (Eritrean Ground Beef & Egg Stew)
steps: Sauté onion in niter kibbeh until soft.
Add berbere and tomato paste, cook until fragrant.
Add ground beef, cook until browned, add a little water and simmer 15 min.
Crack eggs directly into the stew, cover, and cook until just set.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Birsen (Split Pea Puree)
steps: Boil split peas until very soft, about 25-30 min.
Blend or mash into a smooth puree.
Sauté onion, garlic, and cumin in oil, stir into the puree.
Simmer a few more minutes to combine flavors, serve with injera.

dishes.name: Dabo (Ethiopian Bread)
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water, let foam.
Mix flour, salt, oil, and yeast mixture into a soft dough, knead well.
Let rise 1-1.5 hours until doubled.
Shape into a round loaf, let rise again 20 min.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 35-40 min until golden and hollow-sounding.

dishes.name: Mulmul
steps: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water, let foam.
Mix with flour and oil into a soft dough, knead well.
Let rise 45-60 min.
Shape into small rolls, let rise again briefly.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 25-30 min until golden.

dishes.name: Kategna
steps: Melt niter kibbeh and mix with berbere to make a spiced butter paste.
Spread generously over injera.
Lightly toast the coated injera on a dry pan or griddle until warmed and slightly crisp at the edges.
Cut into wedges and serve, often with tea or coffee.

dishes.name: Buna (Ethiopian Coffee)
steps: Wash and roast green coffee beans in a pan over medium heat, stirring constantly until dark brown and fragrant.
Grind the roasted beans coarsely.
Boil water in a traditional jebena (coffee pot) or saucepan, add ground coffee.
Simmer gently, let grounds settle, then pour carefully into small cups.
Serve with sugar to taste, traditionally in three rounds (abol, tona, baraka).

dishes.name: Tej (Honey Wine)
steps: Dissolve honey in water thoroughly.
Add gesho, cover, and let ferment at room temperature 1-2 weeks, stirring occasionally.
Strain out the gesho once fermentation reaches desired tartness and alcohol level.
Bottle and let age further for a smoother flavor, then serve chilled.

dishes.name: Shiro Fitfit
steps: Make shiro sauce as usual: sauté onion and garlic, whisk in shiro powder and water, simmer until thickened.
Toss torn injera pieces into the shiro sauce until well coated.
Serve warm, often for breakfast or a quick meal.

dishes.name: Denche (Boiled Corn & Beans)
steps: Soak corn and beans overnight if using dried.
Boil together in salted water 35-40 min until both are tender.
Drain and serve warm as a simple snack.

dishes.name: Bamya Wat (Okra Stew)
steps: Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomato, and berbere, cook until fragrant.
Add okra, cook gently 15-18 min, stirring occasionally, until tender.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
dishes.description: Roman pasta dish with a creamy egg-and-cheese sauce, no cream used traditionally.
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente.
While pasta cooks, whisk eggs with grated pecorino and plenty of black pepper.
Render pancetta in a pan until crisp.
Off the heat, toss hot drained pasta with the pancetta and its fat, then quickly stir in the egg mixture until it forms a creamy sauce (the pasta's residual heat cooks the eggs).
Serve immediately with extra pecorino and pepper.

dishes.name: Pizza Margherita
dishes.description: Classic Neapolitan pizza topped simply with tomato, mozzarella, and basil.
steps: Stretch pizza dough into a round on a floured surface.
Spread a thin layer of tomato sauce, leaving a border for the crust.
Top with torn mozzarella and a drizzle of olive oil.
Bake at the highest oven temperature (500°F/260°C or hotter) for 8-12 minutes until the crust is blistered and cheese is bubbling.
Finish with fresh basil leaves before serving.

dishes.name: Risotto alla Milanese
dishes.description: Creamy saffron-infused rice dish from Milan.

dishes.name: Tacos al Pastor
dishes.description: Marinated, spit-roasted pork tacos with a touch of sweet pineapple.
steps: Marinate thin-sliced pork in a blended sauce of dried chiles, achiote, pineapple, and spices for at least 2 hours.
Stack marinated pork and grill or roast until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Slice the meat thinly.
Warm small corn tortillas.
Fill tortillas with meat, diced pineapple, onion, and cilantro.

dishes.name: Mole Poblano
dishes.description: Rich, complex sauce blending chiles and chocolate, served over chicken.
steps: Toast and rehydrate dried chiles, then blend with tomato, spices, nuts, and a small amount of chocolate.
Fry the blended paste in oil, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add broth gradually and simmer 45 minutes until thick and deeply flavored.
Poach or roast chicken separately.
Ladle the mole sauce generously over the chicken and serve with tortillas.

dishes.name: Chiles Rellenos
dishes.description: Stuffed, battered, and fried peppers in a light tomato sauce.

dishes.name: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
dishes.description: Creamy tomato-based curry, mild and rich.
steps: Marinate chicken pieces in yogurt, garam masala, and ginger-garlic paste for at least an hour.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken until charred at the edges.
Make the sauce: sauté onion, garlic, and ginger, then add tomato puree and simmer until thickened.
Stir in butter and cream, then add the cooked chicken.
Simmer 10 minutes and finish with a pinch of garam masala.

dishes.name: Chana Masala
dishes.description: Spiced chickpea curry, a staple vegetarian dish.
steps: Sauté onion until golden, then add garlic and ginger.
Add tomato and cook until it breaks down into a thick base.
Stir in garam masala, cumin, and coriander, cooking until fragrant.
Add chickpeas and a splash of water, simmer 15-20 minutes.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon and fresh cilantro.

dishes.name: Biryani
dishes.description: Layered, fragrant spiced rice dish, cooked with meat or vegetables.
steps: Marinate meat in yogurt and biryani spices for at least an hour.
Partially cook basmati rice in salted water with whole spices, then drain.
Cook the marinated meat until nearly done.
Layer the rice over the meat in a heavy pot, top with fried onions and saffron milk.
Cover tightly and cook on low heat (dum) for 20-25 minutes so the flavors steam together.

dishes.name: Dal Tadka
dishes.description: Simple, comforting lentil dish tempered with spiced ghee.

dishes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
dishes.description: Sichuan stir-fry balancing spicy, savory, and nutty flavors.
steps: Marinate diced chicken in soy sauce and cornstarch.
Stir-fry chicken in hot oil until just cooked, then remove.
Stir-fry dried chiles and Sichuan peppercorns briefly until fragrant.
Return chicken to the wok with peanuts and a mixed sauce of soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar.
Toss everything together over high heat for 1-2 minutes and serve immediately.

dishes.name: Mapo Tofu
dishes.description: Spicy, numbing tofu dish from Sichuan cuisine.

dishes.name: Dim Sum (Har Gow)
dishes.description: Steamed translucent dumplings filled with shrimp, a Cantonese classic.

dishes.name: Nigiri Sushi
dishes.description: Hand-pressed rice topped with a slice of fresh fish.
steps: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt while warm.
Let the rice cool to room temperature.
Wet your hands and shape small oblong mounds of rice.
Slice very fresh fish into thin pieces.
Press a piece of fish onto each rice mound, with a touch of wasabi in between.

dishes.name: Ramen
dishes.description: Noodle soup with rich broth, a Japanese comfort food staple.
steps: Prepare a rich broth (pork or soy-based) by simmering bones and aromatics for several hours.
Cook fresh ramen noodles separately until just tender.
Prepare toppings: sliced chashu pork, soft-boiled egg, scallion, nori.
Ladle hot broth into a bowl, add the drained noodles.
Arrange toppings over the noodles and serve immediately.

dishes.name: Okonomiyaki
dishes.description: Savory grilled pancake, customizable with various toppings.

dishes.name: Bibimbap
dishes.description: Mixed rice bowl with vegetables, egg, and spicy chili paste.

dishes.name: Kimchi Jjigae
dishes.description: Spicy fermented cabbage stew, a Korean home-cooking staple.

dishes.name: Bulgogi
dishes.description: Sweet-savory marinated grilled beef.

dishes.name: Pad Thai
dishes.description: Sweet-sour-savory stir-fried noodle dish.
steps: Soak rice noodles in warm water until pliable, then drain.
Stir-fry shrimp or chicken in a hot wok, then push to the side.
Scramble an egg in the same wok.
Add the noodles with tamarind sauce, fish sauce, and sugar, tossing to combine.
Fold in bean sprouts and top with crushed peanuts and lime.

dishes.name: Thai Green Curry
dishes.description: Fragrant, spicy coconut-based curry.

dishes.name: Tom Yum Goong
dishes.description: Hot and sour Thai shrimp soup.

dishes.name: Phở
dishes.description: Aromatic Vietnamese noodle soup, often eaten for breakfast.
steps: Simmer beef bones and charred onion and ginger for several hours to build a clear, aromatic broth.
Season the broth with fish sauce and star anise.
Cook rice noodles separately until tender.
Place thin raw beef slices and noodles in a bowl.
Ladle the boiling broth over the top to cook the beef, then finish with herbs, bean sprouts, and lime.

dishes.name: Bánh Mì
dishes.description: Vietnamese baguette sandwich blending French and local flavors.

dishes.name: Nasi Goreng
dishes.description: Indonesian fried rice, sweet and savory with a fried egg on top.

dishes.name: Beef Rendang
dishes.description: Slow-cooked, deeply spiced dry beef curry from Sumatra.

dishes.name: Hummus
dishes.description: Smooth chickpea and tahini dip, a Levantine staple.
steps: Blend cooked chickpeas with tahini, lemon juice, and garlic until smooth.
Add ice water gradually while blending to achieve a light, creamy texture.
Season with salt and cumin to taste.
Spread onto a plate, swirl the surface with a spoon.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or vegetables.

dishes.name: Tabbouleh
dishes.description: Herb-heavy bulgur salad, light and refreshing.

dishes.name: Shawarma
dishes.description: Marinated meat roasted on a vertical spit, served wrapped or plated.
steps: Marinate thin-sliced chicken or lamb in a spice blend and yogurt overnight.
Stack the marinated meat and roast, slicing off crispy edges as they form (or pan-sear if not using a spit).
Warm pita bread.
Spread garlic sauce or tahini on the pita.
Fill with sliced meat, pickles, and tomato, then wrap tightly.

dishes.name: Turkish Kebab (Şiş)
dishes.description: Skewered grilled meat, a Turkish grilling staple.

dishes.name: Baklava
dishes.description: Layered pastry dessert soaked in sweet syrup.
steps: Layer sheets of phyllo dough in a baking pan, brushing each layer with melted butter.
Scatter a mixture of chopped walnuts or pistachios and cinnamon partway through layering.
Continue layering phyllo on top, then cut into diamond shapes before baking.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) until golden and crisp, about 45 minutes.
Pour a cooled honey-sugar syrup over the hot baklava and let it soak in before serving.

dishes.name: Fesenjan
dishes.description: Sweet-tart Persian stew with ground walnuts and pomegranate.

dishes.name: Chicken Tagine
dishes.description: Slow-cooked stew named after the conical clay pot it's cooked in.
steps: Brown chicken pieces in a tagine or heavy pot with olive oil.
Add onion, garlic, and a blend of warming spices, cooking until fragrant.
Add preserved lemon, olives, and a little broth or water.
Cover and simmer gently for 40-45 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Serve with couscous or bread, spooning the sauce over the top.

dishes.name: Couscous Royale
dishes.description: Festive steamed semolina dish with mixed meats and vegetables.

dishes.name: Koshari
dishes.description: Layered carb-heavy street food, Egypt's national dish.
steps: Cook rice, lentils, and small pasta separately.
Fry sliced onions until deeply crispy and golden.
Make a tangy tomato sauce with garlic and vinegar.
Layer the rice, lentils, and pasta in a bowl.
Top with tomato sauce and crispy onions before serving.

dishes.name: Jollof Rice
dishes.description: One-pot spiced tomato rice dish, a West African staple with friendly national rivalry.
steps: Blend tomato, pepper, and onion into a smooth base.
Fry the blended base in oil until reduced and deeply colored.
Add rice and stock, stirring to coat every grain.
Cover and cook on low heat until the rice is tender and has absorbed the sauce.
Fluff with a fork and serve with fried plantain or protein of choice.

dishes.name: Egusi Soup
dishes.description: Thick soup made from ground melon seeds, eaten with pounded yam or fufu.

dishes.name: Suya
dishes.description: Spicy skewered grilled beef coated in a peanut-based spice mix.
steps: Mix ground peanuts with chili powder, ginger, and other suya spices to make yaji.
Thread thin beef strips onto skewers.
Coat the skewers generously with the yaji spice mix.
Grill over open flame, turning often, until charred and cooked through.
Serve with sliced onion, tomato, and extra spice on the side.

dishes.name: Waakye
dishes.description: Rice and beans dish colored naturally by dried sorghum leaves.

dishes.name: Nyama Choma
dishes.description: Simply seasoned grilled meat, a social centerpiece dish in Kenya.

dishes.name: Ugali
dishes.description: Stiff maize porridge, a staple starch across East Africa.

dishes.name: Bobotie
dishes.description: Spiced baked minced meat dish topped with an egg custard layer.

dishes.name: Feijoada
dishes.description: Hearty black bean and pork stew, Brazil's national dish.
steps: Soak black beans overnight, then cook with pork and beef cuts until tender, several hours.
Skim fat as it renders out during cooking.
Sauté garlic and onion, then stir into the beans to deepen the flavor.
Simmer everything together until the beans are thick and the meat is falling apart.
Serve with white rice, orange slices, and sautéed collard greens.

dishes.name: Empanadas
dishes.description: Baked or fried stuffed pastry, common across Latin America.
steps: Make or use pre-made pastry dough and cut into rounds.
Cook a filling of ground beef (or cheese) with onion and spices.
Spoon filling onto each round, fold over, and crimp the edges.
Bake or fry until golden.
Serve warm, often with a dipping sauce.

dishes.name: Ceviche
dishes.description: Fish 'cooked' in citrus juice, Peru's signature dish.
steps: Cut very fresh raw fish into small cubes.
Cover the fish generously with fresh lime juice and refrigerate 15-20 minutes until the fish turns opaque ('cooking' in the acid).
Mix in diced red onion, chili, and cilantro.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve chilled, often with sweet potato or corn on the side.

dishes.name: Arepas
dishes.description: Grilled or fried corn cakes, often split and stuffed with fillings.
steps: Mix masarepa corn flour with water and salt to form a soft dough.
Shape into flat discs.
Cook on a hot griddle or pan until a crust forms on both sides, about 5 minutes per side.
Finish in the oven if needed to cook through the center.
Split open and stuff with cheese, meat, or beans.

dishes.name: Paella
dishes.description: Iconic saffron rice dish from Valencia.
steps: Sauté chicken (and/or seafood) in a wide paella pan until browned.
Add sofrito (onion, garlic, tomato) and cook until softened.
Stir in rice and toast briefly, then add hot saffron-infused broth.
Simmer without stirring, letting the rice absorb the liquid and develop a crust (socarrat) on the bottom.
Rest a few minutes before serving directly from the pan.

dishes.name: Gazpacho
dishes.description: Chilled raw vegetable soup, popular in hot Andalusian summers.
steps: Roughly chop tomato, cucumber, bell pepper, garlic, and stale bread.
Blend everything with olive oil, vinegar, and a little water until smooth.
Season with salt and adjust the vinegar to taste.
Chill for at least an hour before serving.
Garnish with a drizzle of olive oil and diced vegetables.

dishes.name: Moussaka
dishes.description: Layered baked eggplant and spiced meat casserole.
steps: Salt and roast or fry sliced eggplant until softened.
Cook ground lamb with onion, garlic, and tomato until rich and thick.
Make a bechamel sauce with butter, flour, and milk.
Layer eggplant and meat sauce in a baking dish, topping with bechamel.
Bake at 350°F (180°C) for 45 minutes until golden on top.

dishes.name: Souvlaki
dishes.description: Grilled meat skewers, a Greek street food staple.

dishes.name: Coq au Vin
dishes.description: Classic French braise of chicken in red wine.
steps: Brown chicken pieces in a heavy pot, then set aside.
Sauté bacon, pearl onions, and mushrooms in the same pot.
Return the chicken, add red wine and broth, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise on low heat for 45 minutes to an hour until the chicken is tender.
Thicken the sauce slightly before serving with crusty bread or potatoes.

dishes.name: Ratatouille
dishes.description: Provençal stewed vegetable dish.
steps: Slice eggplant, zucchini, and bell pepper.
Sauté each vegetable separately to preserve their individual textures, then set aside.
Make a tomato and onion base, seasoned with herbes de Provence.
Combine all the vegetables with the tomato base.
Simmer gently until everything melds together, about 20-30 minutes.

dishes.name: Beef Bourguignon
dishes.description: Slow-braised beef in Burgundy red wine.
steps: Brown beef chunks in batches, then set aside.
Sauté bacon, carrot, and onion in the same pot.
Return the beef, add red wine and broth, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and braise in a low oven (325°F/160°C) for 2.5-3 hours until very tender.
Add sautéed mushrooms and pearl onions near the end.

dishes.name: Wiener Schnitzel
dishes.description: Thin breaded and fried cutlet, an Austrian classic.
steps: Pound veal or pork cutlets until thin and even.
Dredge each cutlet in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Fry in butter or oil until golden and crisp on both sides.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve with a wedge of lemon.

dishes.name: Pierogi
key_ingredients: potato and cheese or meat filling
dishes.description: Filled dumplings, boiled or pan-fried, a Polish staple.

ingredients.name: potato and cheese or meat filling

ingredient_names: potato and cheese or meat filling
steps: Make a simple dough from flour, water, and egg, then rest it.
Roll thin and cut into rounds.
Fill each round with mashed potato and cheese (or your chosen filling), then fold and crimp closed.
Boil the pierogi until they float, a few minutes.
Finish by pan-frying in butter until lightly golden, if desired.

dishes.name: Borscht
dishes.description: Beet-based soup, served hot or cold, deep red in color.
steps: Sauté onion, carrot, and beet in a large pot.
Add shredded cabbage, potato, and broth, then simmer until vegetables are tender.
Season with vinegar or lemon juice to bring out the beet's tang.
Simmer 30-40 minutes total.
Serve hot or cold with a dollop of sour cream.

dishes.name: Beef Wellington
dishes.description: Beef tenderloin wrapped in mushroom paste and puff pastry.
steps: Sear a beef tenderloin quickly on all sides, then let it cool.
Spread a layer of mushroom duxelles over the beef.
Wrap the beef in prosciutto, then in puff pastry, sealing the edges.
Brush with egg wash and score the top.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) until the pastry is golden and the beef reaches desired doneness, about 25-35 minutes.

dishes.name: Fish and Chips
dishes.description: Battered fried fish with chunky fried potatoes.
steps: Cut potatoes into thick chips and fry once at a lower temperature to cook through.
Make a beer batter with flour, beer, and a pinch of baking powder.
Dip fish fillets in the batter and fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Fry the chips a second time at a higher temperature until crisp.
Serve together with malt vinegar and tartar sauce.

dishes.name: Jerk Chicken
dishes.description: Spicy marinated, smoke-grilled chicken.
steps: Blend scotch bonnet pepper, allspice, thyme, garlic, and scallion into a marinade.
Marinate chicken in the mixture for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.
Grill over indirect heat, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through.
Baste with extra marinade partway through cooking.
Rest briefly before serving.

dishes.name: Gumbo
dishes.description: Louisiana Creole stew with a deep roux base.
steps: Make a dark roux by cooking flour and oil together slowly until deep brown.
Add the trinity (onion, celery, bell pepper) and cook until softened.
Add broth gradually, stirring to avoid lumps.
Add sausage and/or seafood and simmer 45 minutes to an hour.
Serve over rice.

dishes.name: Poutine
dishes.description: Fries topped with cheese curds and hot gravy, a Quebec classic.

dishes.name: Butter Naan
dishes.description: Soft leavened flatbread cooked in a tandoor.

dishes.name: Nihari
dishes.description: Slow-cooked, richly spiced meat stew, often a breakfast dish.

dishes.name: Doro Tibs
steps: Sear chicken in hot niter kibbeh until browned.
Add onion and rosemary, cook until softened.
Add jalapeño and berbere if using, cook 5 more minutes.
Serve hot with injera or bread.

dishes.name: Yebeg Tibs (Lamb Tibs)
steps: Sear lamb cubes in hot niter kibbeh until browned.
Add onion and rosemary, cook until softened.
Add jalapeño, cook 5 more minutes until lamb is tender but not overcooked.
Serve sizzling with injera.

dishes.name: Kitcha Fitfit
steps: Cook a thick unleavened flatbread on a dry griddle, then tear into small pieces.
Melt niter kibbeh with berbere.
Toss torn bread in the spiced butter until coated.
Serve warm, often with a side of yogurt.

dishes.name: Kikil
steps: Simmer beef shank in water with onion, garlic, and ginger until very tender, about 1.5 hours.
Stir in turmeric during the last 20 minutes.
Serve in its light broth with injera, often with a squeeze of lemon and awaze on the side.

dishes.name: Kwalima (Eritrean Spiced Sausage)
steps: Mix ground beef thoroughly with berbere and garlic.
Stuff into casings if using, or shape into patties.
Air-dry briefly, then pan-fry or grill until cooked through.
Slice and serve as part of a mixed platter.

dishes.name: Enkulal Firfir (Spiced Scrambled Eggs)
steps: Sauté onion and tomato in niter kibbeh until soft.
Stir in berbere, cook until fragrant.
Add beaten eggs, scramble gently until just set.
Serve warm with bread or injera.

dishes.name: Buticha
steps: Blend cooked chickpeas (or reconstituted chickpea flour) into a smooth paste with a little water.
Mix in lemon juice, minced jalapeño, onion, and olive oil.
Season with salt, serve cold or at room temperature as a dip with injera or bread.

dishes.name: Dinich Wat (Spicy Potato Stew)
steps: Sauté onion in oil until soft.
Add berbere and garlic, cook until fragrant.
Add potatoes and a splash of water, cover and cook 20 min until tender.
Serve with injera.

dishes.name: Awaze Tibs
steps: Sear beef in hot niter kibbeh until browned.
Add onion and rosemary, cook until softened.
Stir in awaze sauce, cook 3-4 more minutes.
Serve hot with injera.

dishes.name: Lasagna
dishes.description: Layered baked pasta dish with meat sauce, cheese, and bechamel.

dishes.name: Tiramisu
dishes.description: Coffee-soaked layered dessert with mascarpone cream.

dishes.name: Enchiladas
dishes.description: Rolled tortillas filled with meat and covered in chili sauce.
steps: Cook and shred chicken, then mix with a little sauce.
Warm corn tortillas so they're pliable.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, roll tightly, and place seam-side down in a baking dish.
Cover generously with red or green enchilada sauce and cheese.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) until bubbling, about 20 minutes.

dishes.name: Guacamole
dishes.description: Mashed avocado dip, a Mexican staple.
steps: Mash ripe avocado in a bowl, leaving some texture.
Stir in finely diced onion, tomato, and chili.
Add lime juice and chopped cilantro.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

dishes.name: Samosa
dishes.description: Fried pastry filled with spiced potatoes and peas.
steps: Make a stiff dough from flour, water, and a little oil, then rest it.
Cook a filling of spiced potato and peas.
Roll dough thin, cut into semicircles, and fold into cones.
Fill each cone and seal the edges.
Deep fry until golden and crisp.

dishes.name: Palak Paneer
dishes.description: Creamy spinach curry with cubes of fresh cheese.
steps: Blanch spinach briefly, then blend into a smooth puree.
Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until soft.
Add spices and the spinach puree, simmering a few minutes.
Fold in cubed paneer and warm through.
Finish with a swirl of cream before serving.

dishes.name: Tandoori Chicken
dishes.description: Yogurt-marinated chicken roasted at high heat, traditionally in a tandoor.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, tandoori masala, and lemon juice for at least 4 hours, ideally overnight.
Skewer the chicken pieces.
Roast in a very hot oven or grill, turning occasionally, until charred at the edges and cooked through.
Baste with a little melted butter partway through.
Serve with lemon wedges and sliced onion.

dishes.name: Masala Dosa
dishes.description: Crispy fermented rice-lentil crepe filled with spiced potato.

dishes.name: Peking Duck
dishes.description: Roasted duck with crisp skin, served wrapped in thin pancakes.

dishes.name: Sweet and Sour Pork
dishes.description: Battered fried pork in a tangy sweet-sour sauce.
steps: Cut pork into chunks, coat in cornstarch, and deep-fry until crisp.
Stir-fry bell pepper and pineapple briefly.
Make a sauce from vinegar, sugar, ketchup, and a little soy sauce.
Combine the sauce with the vegetables and bring to a simmer until thickened.
Toss in the fried pork just before serving to keep it crisp.

dishes.name: Hot and Sour Soup
dishes.description: Tangy, peppery soup balancing heat and sourness.

dishes.name: Xiaolongbao (Soup Dumplings)
dishes.description: Steamed dumplings that burst with hot broth inside.

dishes.name: Tempura
dishes.description: Lightly battered and fried seafood or vegetables.
steps: Make a very cold, light batter from flour, egg, and ice water — don't overmix.
Dip shrimp or vegetable pieces into the batter.
Fry in hot oil in small batches until light and crisp, not browned.
Drain on a rack.
Serve immediately with a soy-based dipping sauce.

dishes.name: Tonkatsu
dishes.description: Breaded, deep-fried pork cutlet, a Japanese comfort food.
steps: Pound a pork cutlet to an even thickness.
Dredge in flour, then egg, then panko breadcrumbs.
Fry in oil until deeply golden and cooked through.
Rest briefly, then slice into strips.
Serve with shredded cabbage and tonkatsu sauce.

dishes.name: Miso Soup
dishes.description: Simple fermented soybean paste soup, a daily staple.
steps: Bring dashi stock to a gentle simmer.
Add cubed tofu and reconstituted wakame seaweed.
Remove from heat and whisk in miso paste (boiling can dull its flavor).
Stir until the miso is fully dissolved.
Garnish with sliced scallion before serving.

dishes.name: Takoyaki
dishes.description: Ball-shaped savory snack filled with diced octopus.

dishes.name: Japchae
dishes.description: Stir-fried glass noodles with vegetables, sweet and savory.
steps: Soak sweet potato noodles until pliable, then boil briefly until tender.
Stir-fry sliced vegetables (carrot, spinach, mushroom) separately to keep their textures distinct.
Stir-fry thin beef strips.
Combine noodles, vegetables, and beef with soy sauce, sugar, and sesame oil.
Toss everything together and serve warm or at room temperature.

dishes.name: Tteokbokki
dishes.description: Chewy rice cakes in a spicy-sweet sauce, popular street food.

dishes.name: Massaman Curry
dishes.description: Mild, rich curry with Persian and Indian influences.
steps: Fry massaman curry paste in a little coconut cream until fragrant.
Add chunks of beef and brown lightly.
Pour in the rest of the coconut milk, potato, and peanuts.
Simmer slowly until the meat is very tender, about an hour.
Season with tamarind and palm sugar to balance sweet, sour, and savory.

dishes.name: Som Tam (Papaya Salad)
dishes.description: Spicy-sour shredded green papaya salad.

dishes.name: Bún Chả
dishes.description: Grilled pork served with rice noodles and herbs in dipping broth.

dishes.name: Gado-Gado
dishes.description: Indonesian salad with a rich peanut dressing.

dishes.name: Satay
dishes.description: Grilled skewered meat served with peanut dipping sauce.

dishes.name: Falafel
dishes.description: Fried chickpea patties, a Levantine staple often served in pita.
steps: Soak dried chickpeas overnight (do not use canned, they're too soft).
Blend the soaked chickpeas with garlic, herbs, and spices into a coarse paste.
Rest the mixture, then shape into small balls or patties.
Deep fry until deeply golden and crisp outside.
Serve in pita with tahini sauce and salad.

dishes.name: Fattoush
dishes.description: Crisp salad topped with toasted or fried pita chips.

dishes.name: Mujadara
dishes.description: Simple lentil and rice dish topped with crispy onions.

dishes.name: Menemen
dishes.description: Turkish scrambled eggs cooked with tomato and peppers.

dishes.name: Lahmacun
dishes.description: Thin, crispy flatbread topped with spiced minced meat.

dishes.name: Tahdig
dishes.description: Persian rice with a coveted crispy golden crust.

dishes.name: Kebab Koobideh
dishes.description: Seasoned ground meat kebabs, a Persian grilling classic.

dishes.name: Harira
dishes.description: Hearty tomato-based soup, traditionally eaten to break the Ramadan fast.

dishes.name: Pastilla
dishes.description: Sweet-savory pie layering spiced meat and almonds in flaky pastry.

dishes.name: Pepper Soup
dishes.description: Light, fiery peppery broth, often used as a warming remedy.

dishes.name: Moin Moin
dishes.description: Steamed bean pudding, often wrapped in leaves or foil.

dishes.name: Banku
dishes.description: Fermented, cooked dough staple, eaten with soup or stew.

dishes.name: Kelewele
dishes.description: Spiced, fried plantain cubes, a popular Ghanaian street snack.

dishes.name: Sukuma Wiki
dishes.description: Simple sautéed greens, a daily staple across East Africa.

dishes.name: Biltong
dishes.description: Air-dried, cured meat snack, similar to jerky but distinct in seasoning.

dishes.name: Brigadeiro
dishes.description: Fudgy chocolate truffle, a staple at Brazilian celebrations.

dishes.name: Pão de Queijo
dishes.description: Chewy, cheesy baked bread rolls.

dishes.name: Moqueca
dishes.description: Brazilian fish stew simmered in coconut milk and palm oil.

dishes.name: Asado
dishes.description: Argentine barbecue tradition centered on slow-grilled meats.

dishes.name: Lomo Saltado
dishes.description: Peruvian stir-fry blending Chinese and Latin American technique.

dishes.name: Tortilla Española
dishes.description: Thick Spanish potato and egg omelette.
steps: Slice potatoes and onion thinly, then slowly cook in olive oil until soft (not browned).
Drain the potatoes and onion, reserving the oil.
Beat eggs and mix in the potato and onion.
Pour back into a hot pan with a little of the reserved oil, cooking until mostly set.
Flip carefully (using a plate) to cook the other side, then slide back into the pan to finish.

dishes.name: Churros
dishes.description: Fried dough pastry, crisp outside and soft inside.
steps: Bring water, butter, and salt to a boil, then stir in flour to form a thick dough.
Beat in eggs one at a time until smooth and glossy.
Pipe strips of dough directly into hot oil.
Fry until deeply golden, turning as needed.
Toss the hot churros in cinnamon sugar before serving.

dishes.name: Spanakopita
dishes.description: Flaky pastry filled with spinach and feta.
steps: Sauté spinach with onion until wilted, then let cool and drain excess liquid.
Mix the spinach with crumbled feta and a beaten egg.
Layer sheets of phyllo dough, brushing each with melted butter.
Spread the spinach filling and fold or roll the phyllo around it.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) until golden and crisp, about 30-35 minutes.

dishes.name: Quiche Lorraine
dishes.description: Savory egg custard tart with bacon and cheese.
steps: Line a tart pan with pastry dough and blind bake briefly.
Cook bacon until crisp and scatter it over the base along with grated gruyere.
Whisk eggs with cream and a little nutmeg.
Pour the egg mixture over the bacon and cheese.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) until just set, about 30-35 minutes.

dishes.name: Croissant
dishes.description: Flaky, buttery layered pastry, a French breakfast staple.
steps: Make a yeasted dough and chill it.
Encase a block of cold butter in the dough and roll it out.
Fold the dough over itself in thirds, chill, then repeat this laminating process several times.
Roll out, cut into triangles, and roll each into a crescent shape.
Proof until puffy, then bake at 400°F (200°C) until deeply golden and flaky.

dishes.name: Sauerbraten
dishes.description: Marinated pot roast, Germany's traditional sour braised beef.

dishes.name: Currywurst
dishes.description: Sliced sausage doused in curry-spiced ketchup, a Berlin street food icon.

dishes.name: Pelmeni
dishes.description: Small boiled dumplings filled with seasoned meat.

dishes.name: Beef Stroganoff
dishes.description: Sautéed beef in a creamy mushroom sauce, served over noodles or rice.

dishes.name: Shepherd's Pie
dishes.description: Baked minced meat topped with mashed potato.
steps: Brown ground lamb with onion and carrot.
Stir in a little flour and stock to thicken into a gravy, then add peas.
Spread the meat mixture into a baking dish.
Top with a thick layer of mashed potato, smoothing or fluffing the top.
Bake at 400°F (200°C) until the potato is golden, about 20-25 minutes.

dishes.name: Mac and Cheese
dishes.description: Creamy baked or stovetop pasta and cheese classic.
steps: Cook macaroni until al dente.
Make a roux with butter and flour, then whisk in milk to form a smooth sauce.
Stir in shredded cheddar until melted and smooth.
Combine the cheese sauce with the cooked macaroni.
Bake with a breadcrumb topping until bubbly, or serve straight from the stovetop.

dishes.name: Buffalo Wings
dishes.description: Fried chicken wings tossed in spicy butter sauce.
steps: Pat chicken wings dry and season lightly.
Fry or bake the wings until crisp and fully cooked.
Melt butter and whisk with hot sauce.
Toss the hot wings in the butter-hot sauce mixture until fully coated.
Serve with blue cheese dip and celery sticks.

dishes.name: Chicken Adobo
dishes.description: Braised chicken in soy sauce and vinegar, the Philippines' de facto national dish.

dishes.name: Laksa
dishes.description: Spicy coconut curry noodle soup blending Chinese and Malay flavors.

dishes.name: Hainanese Chicken Rice
dishes.description: Poached chicken served with rice cooked in chicken fat and broth.

dishes.name: Arancini
dishes.description: Fried, breaded risotto balls, a Sicilian street food staple.

dishes.name: Focaccia
dishes.description: Flat oven-baked Italian bread, dimpled and drizzled with olive oil.

dishes.name: Panzanella
dishes.description: Tuscan bread and tomato salad, a way to use up day-old bread.

dishes.name: Caprese Salad
dishes.description: Simple sliced tomato and mozzarella salad in the colors of the Italian flag.

dishes.name: Pesto alla Genovese
dishes.description: Bright, herby sauce from Liguria, traditionally pounded in a mortar.

dishes.name: Cassoulet
dishes.description: Slow-cooked white bean casserole from southwestern France.

dishes.name: Bouillabaisse
dishes.description: Provençal fish stew from the port city of Marseille.

dishes.name: Croque Monsieur
dishes.description: Grilled ham and cheese sandwich topped with bechamel sauce.

dishes.name: Salade Niçoise
dishes.description: Composed salad from Nice with tuna, olives, and hard-boiled egg.

dishes.name: French Onion Soup
dishes.description: Rich onion soup topped with melted cheese over toasted bread.

dishes.name: Duck Confit
dishes.description: Duck slow-cooked and preserved in its own fat until tender.

dishes.name: Patatas Bravas
dishes.description: Fried potato cubes served with a spicy sauce, a classic Spanish tapa.

dishes.name: Pisto
dishes.description: Spanish vegetable medley similar to ratatouille, often topped with a fried egg.

dishes.name: Fabada Asturiana
dishes.description: Hearty bean stew from Asturias with cured meats.

dishes.name: Bacalhau à Brás
dishes.description: Shredded salt cod scrambled with potato straws and egg.

dishes.name: Caldo Verde
dishes.description: Portuguese green soup with shredded kale and sliced sausage.

dishes.name: Pastel de Nata
dishes.description: Portuguese custard tart with a flaky, caramelized top.

dishes.name: Francesinha
dishes.description: Porto's indulgent layered sandwich smothered in a spicy tomato-beer sauce.

dishes.name: Bratwurst
dishes.description: Grilled German sausage, often served with mustard and a roll.
steps: Simmer bratwurst gently in beer with onions for about 10 minutes (optional but classic).
Finish the sausages on a hot grill until browned and crisp outside.
Toast a bread roll.
Serve the sausage in the roll with mustard and the cooked onions.

dishes.name: Pretzel
dishes.description: Chewy, knot-shaped German bread with a distinctive dark crust.

dishes.name: Kartoffelsalat
dishes.description: German potato salad, served warm with a tangy vinegar dressing.

dishes.name: Black Forest Cake
dishes.description: Layered chocolate cake with cherries and cream, named after the Black Forest region.
steps: Bake chocolate sponge cake layers and let them cool.
Soak the layers lightly with kirsch (cherry brandy).
Whip cream and spread between the layers along with cherries.
Stack the layers, frosting the outside with more whipped cream.
Decorate with chocolate shavings and whole cherries.

dishes.name: Irish Stew
dishes.description: Simple, hearty lamb and root vegetable stew.

dishes.name: Haggis
dishes.description: Scotland's savory pudding of seasoned offal and oats, traditionally served with neeps and tatties.

dishes.name: Bangers and Mash
dishes.description: British comfort food pairing sausages with mashed potato and gravy.

dishes.name: Stroopwafel
dishes.description: Thin waffle cookies sandwiched with a caramel filling.

dishes.name: Moules Frites
dishes.description: Steamed mussels served with a side of crispy fries, Belgium's signature dish.

dishes.name: Bitterballen
dishes.description: Deep-fried Dutch meat croquettes, a popular bar snack.

dishes.name: Cheese Fondue
dishes.description: Melted cheese shared communally, eaten by dipping bread on long forks.
steps: Rub the inside of a fondue pot with a cut garlic clove.
Heat white wine gently, then gradually melt in grated gruyere and emmental, stirring constantly.
Toss the cheese with a little cornstarch first to help it stay smooth.
Keep the pot warm over a low flame at the table.
Dip cubes of bread on long forks, swirling to keep the cheese moving.

dishes.name: Raclette
dishes.description: Melted cheese scraped over potatoes and accompaniments, both a dish and a social meal.

dishes.name: Sachertorte
dishes.description: Dense Viennese chocolate cake with a thin layer of apricot jam.
steps: Bake a dense chocolate sponge cake.
Slice the cake in half and spread a thin layer of apricot jam in the middle.
Reassemble and coat the whole cake with more apricot jam.
Pour a glossy chocolate glaze over the top, letting it drip down the sides.
Let the glaze set before slicing and serving, traditionally with whipped cream.

dishes.name: Gyro
dishes.description: Greek wrapped sandwich of spiced meat, similar in spirit to shawarma and doner.
steps: Marinate meat (or stack pre-seasoned meat) and roast on a vertical spit, or pan-sear thin slices.
Slice off crispy edges as they form.
Warm pita bread.
Spread tzatziki on the pita.
Fill with meat, tomato, onion, and more tzatziki, then wrap.

dishes.name: Greek Salad
dishes.description: Simple salad of tomato, cucumber, olives, and feta, no lettuce involved.
steps: Chop tomato, cucumber, and green pepper into large chunks.
Combine with red onion and Kalamata olives in a bowl.
Top with a thick slab of feta cheese.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and a little dried oregano.
Serve without dressing on the vegetables themselves, letting the olive oil do the work.

dishes.name: Ćevapi
dishes.description: Grilled minced meat fingers popular across the former Yugoslavia.

dishes.name: Burek
dishes.description: Flaky spiral or layered pastry filled with meat, cheese, or spinach.

dishes.name: Sarmale
dishes.description: Romanian cabbage rolls stuffed with spiced meat and rice.

dishes.name: Goulash
dishes.description: Hungarian paprika-spiced beef and vegetable stew.

dishes.name: Lángos
dishes.description: Deep-fried Hungarian flatbread, often topped with sour cream and cheese.

dishes.name: Trdelník
dishes.description: Spit-rolled pastry dough coated in cinnamon sugar, popular street food.

dishes.name: Kielbasa
dishes.description: Smoked Polish sausage eaten on its own or in stews.

dishes.name: Smørrebrød
dishes.description: Open-faced Danish sandwich, artfully topped with fish, meat, or cheese.

dishes.name: Köttbullar
dishes.description: Swedish meatballs served with a creamy sauce and tart lingonberry jam.

dishes.name: Gravlax
dishes.description: Cured raw salmon flavored with dill, salt, and sugar.

dishes.name: Lutefisk
dishes.description: Traditional Norwegian dish of whitefish preserved and rehydrated with lye.

dishes.name: Shakshuka
dishes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced tomato and pepper sauce.

dishes.name: Sabich
dishes.description: Israeli pita sandwich built around fried eggplant and egg.

dishes.name: Maqluba
dishes.description: Layered rice and meat dish flipped upside down for serving, its name means 'upside-down'.

dishes.name: Mansaf
dishes.description: Jordan's national dish: lamb cooked in a tangy fermented yogurt sauce over rice.

dishes.name: Kibbeh
dishes.description: Torpedo-shaped fried croquettes of bulgur and spiced minced meat.

dishes.name: Kabsa
dishes.description: Saudi Arabia's spiced rice and meat dish, similar to biryani.
steps: Brown chicken or lamb pieces with kabsa spice blend.
Sauté onion, garlic, and tomato in the same pot.
Add rice and stock, stirring to combine.

steps: Mix ground pork with minced cabbage, scallion, ginger, and soy sauce.

dishes.name: Ackee and Saltfish

steps: Soak salted cod to remove excess salt, then flake it.
Sauté onion, tomato, and pepper.
Add the flaked saltfish and cook briefly.
Gently fold in ackee (careful not to break it up too much) and warm through.
Serve with fried dumplings or breadfruit.

dishes.name: Curry Goat
dishes.description: Jamaican slow-cooked curried goat, a centerpiece of celebrations.
steps: Marinate goat meat in curry powder, garlic, and thyme for several hours or overnight.
Brown the meat in oil with scotch bonnet pepper.
Add water or stock and simmer slowly until the meat is very tender, 1.5-2 hours.
Add potato partway through and cook until soft.
Serve with rice and peas.

dishes.name: Jambalaya

steps: Sauté the trinity (onion, celery, bell pepper) with sausage until browned.
Add rice and toast briefly in the fat.
Add broth, tomato, and Cajun spices, then bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir in shrimp or chicken near the end and cook through.

dishes.name: Lobster Roll
dishes.description: Chilled or buttered lobster meat served in a toasted split-top bun.
steps: Steam or boil lobster until just cooked through, then cool and chop the meat.
Toss the lobster meat lightly with mayonnaise (or melted butter for a warm version), keeping it chunky.
Season with a squeeze of lemon and a little celery for crunch, if desired.
Toast a split-top hot dog bun with butter until golden.
Pile the lobster salad into the toasted bun and serve immediately.

dishes.name: Philly Cheesesteak
dishes.description: Philadelphia's iconic sandwich of griddled beef and cheese.
steps: Thinly slice ribeye or use pre-shaved beef.
Griddle the beef with sliced onion until cooked through, chopping it into smaller pieces as it cooks.
Melt cheese (traditionally Cheez Whiz or provolone) directly over the meat on the griddle.
Scoop the meat and melted cheese into a long hoagie roll.
Serve hot, with or without peppers.

steps: Make a soft yeasted dough and let it rise.
Roll into an oval and pinch up the edges into a boat shape.
Fill with a mix of cheeses.
Bake until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbling.
Crack a raw egg into the center in the last few minutes so it cooks gently in the residual heat, then swirl in a pat of butter before serving.

dishes.name: Khinkali
dishes.description: Georgian soup dumplings, twisted at the top and held by the knot while eaten.
steps: Make a simple flour and water dough and rest it.
Mix ground meat with onion, garlic, and a little broth to keep it juicy.
Roll dough into rounds, add filling, and pleat the edges together into a twisted knot at the top.
Boil the dumplings until they float and the filling is cooked through.
Eat by holding the knot, biting a small opening, and sipping the broth inside before eating the rest.

dishes.description: Smoky roasted eggplant dip, a Levantine mezze staple.
steps: Roast whole eggplants over an open flame or in a hot oven until the skin is charred and the flesh is soft.
Let cool, then peel and scoop out the flesh.
Blend or mash the flesh with tahini, garlic, and lemon juice.
Season with salt and a little cumin.

dishes.name: Provoleta

dishes.name: Pozole
dishes.description: Traditional Mexican hominy soup, festive and deeply regional.
steps: Simmer pork with garlic and onion until tender, several hours.
Blend dried chiles into a smooth sauce and stir into the broth.
Add hominy and simmer another 30 minutes.
Shred the cooked pork and return it to the pot.
Serve with shredded cabbage, radish, lime, and oregano on the side.

dishes.name: Birria
dishes.description: Rich, chili-braised meat stew, often served with tortillas for dipping tacos.
steps: Toast and rehydrate dried chiles, then blend into a marinade with garlic and spices.
Marinate beef or goat in the chile paste for several hours.
Simmer the meat in the marinade with broth until falling-apart tender, 2-3 hours.
Shred the meat and strain the cooking liquid into a consommé.
Serve the meat with warm tortillas and a cup of the consommé for dipping.

dishes.name: Elote
dishes.description: Grilled Mexican street corn slathered in creamy, spiced toppings.
steps: Grill corn on the cob until charred in spots.
Brush with mayonnaise or crema.
Sprinkle generously with crumbled cotija cheese and chili powder.
Squeeze fresh lime juice over the top.
Serve immediately while hot.

dishes.name: Chilaquiles
dishes.description: Mexican breakfast of fried tortilla chips simmered in salsa.
steps: Fry corn tortilla triangles until crisp, or use store-bought chips.
Simmer red or green salsa until slightly thickened.
Toss the crispy chips in the hot salsa just until coated but not soggy.
Top with crumbled cheese and a fried egg.
Serve immediately while the chips still have some crunch.

dishes.name: Tamales
dishes.description: Steamed corn dough parcels filled with meat, cheese, or chilies.
steps: Beat lard or oil into masa dough until light and fluffy.
Spread the masa onto softened corn husks.
Add a spoonful of filling (meat, cheese, or chili) down the center.
Fold the husk around the filling and steam for about an hour until the masa sets.
Unwrap and serve hot.

dishes.name: Mofongo
dishes.description: Mashed fried plantain dish, a Puerto Rican signature.
steps: Cut green plantains into chunks and fry until golden.
Mash the fried plantains with garlic and pork cracklings in a mortar.
Shape the mash into a dome.
Serve alongside garlic sauce or a savory broth poured around the base.
Some versions are stuffed with shrimp or meat in the center.

dishes.name: Arroz con Gandules
dishes.description: Puerto Rico's classic rice and pigeon pea dish.

dishes.name: Conch Fritters
dishes.description: Deep-fried fritters made from local conch, a Bahamian favorite.

dishes.name: Kokoda
dishes.description: Fijian version of ceviche, fish cured in citrus and coconut milk.

dishes.name: Palusami
dishes.description: Taro leaves baked with coconut cream, a Samoan staple.

dishes.name: Beignets
dishes.description: Square, pillowy fried dough dusted heavily with powdered sugar.

dishes.name: Fish Tacos
dishes.description: Crispy battered fish tacos, a Baja California classic adopted widely in the US.

dishes.name: Cobb Salad
dishes.description: Composed American salad with rows of chopped toppings.

dishes.name: Apple Pie
dishes.description: Classic American baked pie, a cultural symbol as much as a dessert.
steps: Make a butter pie dough and chill it.
Toss sliced apples with sugar, cinnamon, and a little flour.
Roll out the dough and line a pie dish with half of it.
Fill with the apple mixture and cover with the second dough round, sealing and venting the top.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 45-50 minutes until the crust is golden and filling is bubbling.

dishes.name: Biscuits and Gravy
dishes.description: Southern breakfast of flaky biscuits smothered in peppery sausage gravy.
steps: Make flaky buttermilk biscuits and bake until golden.
Brown breakfast sausage in a skillet, breaking it into crumbles.
Sprinkle flour over the sausage and cook briefly to form a roux.
Gradually whisk in milk, simmering until thick and peppery.
Split warm biscuits and ladle the sausage gravy generously over the top.

dishes.name: Polenta

dishes.name: Osso Buco

dishes.name: Yakitori
dishes.description: Grilled skewered chicken, glazed with a sweet-savory sauce.

dishes.name: Unagi Don

dishes.description: Rich custard dessert topped with a brittle layer of caramelized sugar.

dishes.name: Profiteroles
dishes.description: Cream-filled pastry puffs drizzled with warm chocolate sauce.

dishes.name: Panna Cotta
